reason: A DSH Web UI plugin that improves plugin inventory navigation by deriving readable names, supporting aliases and filtering, and optionally exposing plugin-switch enable or disable controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 插件清单提供可搜索、可筛选的友好名称，并支持保存自定义别名及在可用时切换插件启停。
summaries.en: Provides searchable and filterable friendly names for the DSH Web UI plugin inventory, with saved aliases and optional plugin enable or disable controls when plugin-switch is available.

capabilities: Reads plugin metadata and descriptions from package.json files
Displays a plugin inventory with search and status filters
Stores user-defined plugin aliases in browser localStorage
Rewrites plugin inventory labels in the web UI
Requests plugin enable or disable actions through the plugin-switch endpoint when available
